```yaml
name: Approve Workflows

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' &&
      (github.event.action == 'labeled' && github.event.label.name == 'ok-to-test') ||
      github.event.action == 'synchronize'
    steps:
      - name: Check if first-time contributor
        id: check-contributor
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_CREATOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # Count PRs by this creator in the repository
          # Using env vars to avoid template injection in the shell command
          PR_COUNT=$(gh api repos/$REPO_NAME/pulls --jq "[.[] | select(.user.login == \"$PR_CREATOR\")] | length")
          
          echo "Creator: $PR_CREATOR"
          echo "PR Count: $PR_COUNT"
          
          # If PR count is 1 or less, they are a first-time contributor
          if [ "$PR_COUNT" -le 1 ]; then
            echo "is_first_time=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_first_time=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check for ok-to-test label
        id: check-label
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVENT_ACTION: ${{ github.event.action }}
          LABEL_NAME: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
        run: |
          HAS_LABEL=false
          if [ "$EVENT_ACTION" == "labeled" ] && [ "$LABEL_NAME" == "ok-to-test" ]; then
            HAS_LABEL=true
          else
            # Check if label exists on the PR
            LABEL_EXISTS=$(gh api repos/$REPO_NAME/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/labels --jq "[.[] | select(.name == \"ok-to-test\")] | length")
            if [ "$LABEL_EXISTS" -gt 0 ]; then
              HAS_LABEL=true
            fi
          fi
          echo "has_ok_to_test=$HAS_LABEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Approve pending workflows
        if: steps.check-contributor.outputs.is_first_time == 'false' || steps.check-label.outputs.has_ok_to_test == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # Get pending workflow runs for this PR
          RUNS=$(gh api repos/$REPO_NAME/actions/runs \
            --jq ".workflow_runs[] | select(.event == \"pull_request\" and .pull_requests[0].number == $PR_NUMBER and .status == \"queued\") | .id")
          
          if [ -z "$RUNS" ]; then
            echo "No pending workflow runs found."
            exit 0
          fi
          
          for RUN_ID in $RUNS; do
            echo "Approving workflow run $RUN_ID"
            gh api repos/$REPO_NAME/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/approvals \
              --method POST \
              --field "state=approved"
          done
```
